title: Tank storage: inlet/outlet mass balance
description: Reusable SVG tank/reservoir component that samples constant inlet/outlet storage balance in absolute time, with explicit full-tank overflow and empty-tank supply-shortfall behavior.
learningObjectives: Apply dV/dt = Qin − Qout to a constant-area tank.
Recognize how physical storage limits convert excess inflow to overflow or unmet outlet demand at an empty tank.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as a real Three.js reservoir/tank storage scene; mass-balance model retained. Rendered visual comparison pending.
